_replaceNotes.wrapper: The app is a FRAGMENT — no page under pages/ contains </head>; HtmlService wraps it at runtime. build-demo.mjs injects the demo shim before </head>, so WITHOUT these first two replacements the shim is silently not injected and the demo loads with no mock backend at all. Same situation as demos/transportation. The two anchors are the first line of Theme.html (first include) and the last lines of StaffApp.html (last include).
_replaceNotes.NEED_LOGIN: MUST be 0. StaffApp.html:151 reads it as === '1' to raise the sign-in overlay. The live source now ships a login gate that the July demo predates — rebuilding without this puts a sign-in wall in front of the demo.
_replaceNotes.WHO: Fabricated; whoEmail() lowercases it and it drives who the app thinks is signed in.
_replaceNotes.EXEC_URL: Deliberately empty — it is the live /exec URL and must never reach a published page.
_replaceNotes.VOL_MEET: Meet-volunteer code; empty so the demo never enters volunteer mode.
_replaceNotes.scrubs: Real-world identifiers (the school domain, live /exec URLs, AKfycb deployment ids) are scrubbed BY PATTERN in tools/build-demo.mjs, not listed here — a config that names the secrets it removes publishes them, and this repo is public.
